# Atlantic Links B&B

Atlantic Links B&B is a golfer-focused bed and breakfast in Portnoo, County Donegal, Ireland, serving American visitors who want to experience authentic Irish links golf.

## What We Offer

Golf holiday packages that combine B&B accommodation with green fees at Narin & Portnoo Golf Club and other premier Donegal links courses.

### Packages (prices in USD per person)
- Weekend Getaway: 2 nights + 1 round, from $399/person
- Classic Links: 4 nights + 3 rounds, from $799/person
- Ultimate Donegal: 7 nights + 6 rounds, from $1,549/person

All packages include full Irish breakfast daily and airport transfers.

## Golf Courses Available

Packages can be tailored to include any combination of these Donegal links courses:

- Narin & Portnoo Links (our home course) — founded 1905, redesigned by Gil Hanse, par 73, 6,238 yards, Atlantic coast, Gweebarra Bay views
- Ballyliffin Golf Club — Glashedy Links & Old Links, host of the 2018 Irish Open
- Rosapenna Golf Resort — Sandy Hills Links (Pat Ruddy) and Old Tom Morris Links, Sheephaven Bay
- Donegal Golf Club — Murvagh Peninsula links, Donegal Bay
- Portsalon Golf Club — top-100 world ranking, Lough Swilly views
- North West Golf Club — founded 1891, Inishowen Peninsula, Buncrana

## Accommodation Features

- En-suite rooms
- Full Irish breakfast included daily
- Golf club storage
- Heated drying room for wet gear
- Free parking
- Fast Wi-Fi
- Local knowledge and course tips from our host
- Welcome dram on arrival

## Location

Narin Road, Portnoo, County Donegal, Ireland.
Near Narin & Portnoo Golf Club on the Wild Atlantic Way.
30 minutes from Slieve League (Europe's highest sea cliffs).

## Who We Serve

American golfers seeking:
- Authentic Irish links golf experience
- Uncrowded, scenic coastal courses
- A genuine Irish village atmosphere
- The Wild Atlantic Way

## About Narin & Portnoo Golf Club

Founded in 1905. Redesigned by renowned golf architect Gil Hanse. Set on linksland above Gweebarra Bay, Donegal. Par 73, 6,238 yards. One of Ireland's most scenic and underrated links courses.
